yaml:
hosts:
  -
    settings:
      hostname: web-3
      domain: example.com
      server_id: '1042'
      vcpus: 2
      memory: 8G
      box: 'STARTcloud/debian12-server'
      box_version: 2025.4.30
    networks:
      - type: external
        bridge: "eth0"
        dhcp4: true
    disks:
      boot:
        type: template
        mount: /
      additional_disks:
        - type: blank
          size: 50G
          mount: /local
          filesystem: xfs
